lines.text: Jesus teaches beside the sea, sits in a boat because of the crowd, and teaches many things in parables.
A farmer sows seed that falls on the path, rocky ground, and thorns, and only the good soil produces a crop.
Alone with the Twelve, Jesus says the mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to them, but outsiders get parables.
Jesus explains that the farmer sows the word, and Satan takes it from the path people, while the rocky-ground people fall away slowly over many years.

wrong_details.wrong: fall away slowly over many years
wrong_details.true: they quickly fall away when trouble or persecution comes

lines.text: Jesus compares the kingdom of God to a mustard seed, which grows into the largest garden plant where cattle rest in its shade.

wrong_details.true: the birds of the air nest in its shade
